name: Ruika-chan o Sukuitai! ~Make Heroine to Loop Suru~
original_name: 涙花ちゃんを救いたい！ ～負けヒロインとループする～
source:
In the final episode of the anime Kirameki★Actors, Itsuki Imai, a former child actor and the anime's protagonist, and Shiraha Fuyutsuki, the main heroine, are drawn together as though they were destined for each other.

But Ruika Harumachi, the girl who brought both of them into the drama club and tried harder than anyone to win his heart, ends up supporting their romance—only to have her own heart broken.

The last thing you see is Ruika sobbing alone in the clubroom.

"I want to save Ruika."

The moment you make that wish, you suddenly find yourself inside the anime.
Standing right in front of you is Ruika herself, moments after her heartbreak.
And then, somehow, the two of you leap back in time to the beginning of the story—
Now Ruika might still have a chance to become the heroine who wins!

Ruika asks for your help, and together you set out to change the story so she can end up with Itsuki.
Unfortunately, changing the story is easier said than done.

You originally planned to support Ruika from the sidelines, but before long, you find yourself joining the drama club, growing unexpectedly close to Shiraha, and causing all kinds of unforeseen changes...

Ruika's plans fail one after another. No matter how many times you start over, she somehow finds a new way to lose in love!

And yet, Ruika refuses to give up.
She cries, she gets mad, she picks herself back up—and keeps fighting against fate.

"No way! This doesn't count! Next time, I'm definitely going to win...!"

Can Ruika finally overcome her fate as a losing heroine and find her own happy ending?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5106660/Save_Ruika_Looping_with_a_Losing_Heroine/]Steam[/url]]
